projects.title: Admissions Management System
projects.problem: The department needed a dynamic admissions portal to process thousands of applications efficiently, replacing out-dated paper processes and disjointed systems without compromising data security.
projects.solution: I built a full-stack applicant tracking and shortlisting system. An Angular frontend provides a seamless applicant experience, while the .NET Core backend handles logic, real-time alerts, and encrypted institutional data compliance.
projects.result: Deployed to production. Handles online applications, document verification and automated merit list generation, with real-time notifications and email alerts for applicants and administrators.

projects.title: Vendor & Applicant Management (CHI)
projects.problem: Processing adhoc job applications for Community Health Inspector roles required a rigorous document scrutiny pipeline with strict role-based access for different reviewer tiers.
projects.solution: A scalable full-stack portal with granular role-based authentication. Reviewers have dedicated dashboards to track document submissions, while admins securely oversee the entire pipeline.
projects.result: Handles high application volumes with optimized Entity Framework and SQL Server queries for fast, scalable data retrieval, plus dashboards for status tracking and applicant communication.
projects.impactMetric: Secure document management at provincial scale

projects.title: Hospital Staff Packages (HSPP)
projects.problem: The provincial health department needed a unified system to manage complex eligibility criteria for hospital staff benefits and special package allocations.
projects.solution: A custom HR reporting and allocation system powered by highly normalized database schemas to handle variable eligibility rules without data duplication.
projects.result: Deployed for the department. Gives department heads on-demand HR reporting dashboards to monitor staff benefits and generate summaries, replacing manual spreadsheet tracking.
projects.impactMetric: On-demand HR reporting for department heads

projects.title: AuthentixAI — Cross-Lingual Deepfake Detection
projects.problem: Deepfake video and synthetic speech are hard for ordinary users to spot, and most detectors ignore low-resource languages such as Urdu.
projects.solution: A cross-lingual audio-video deepfake detection platform built by a 3-person team under faculty supervision. I own the video/image AI pipeline: ViT and CLIP based detection trained and evaluated on FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF v2, with Grad-CAM heatmaps that show which regions drove each prediction. The audio side uses Wav2Vec2 and HuBERT, served through a FastAPI backend with a Next.js interface.
projects.result: A working end-to-end detection platform with explainable results, not just a label, covering both video and Urdu speech.

projects.title: MyTube — Video Sharing Platform
projects.problem: Building a YouTube-style platform end-to-end requires solving for secure auth, large media uploads, and a fast, responsive UI — all under semester-project constraints.
projects.solution: A full-stack video sharing app with a separate Express/MongoDB API and a React 19 client. Auth uses JWT via httpOnly cookies with Bearer-token fallback, media is handled through Cloudinary, and the frontend runs on Redux Toolkit, React Router , and React Hook Form + Zod validation, styled with a YouTube-inspired dark theme in Tailwind CSS.
projects.result: Deployed with a live frontend and a separate backend API repo, demonstrating a production-style split-service architecture rather than a single monolith.
projects.impactMetric: Full-stack split-service architecture (separate frontend & backend repos)

projects.title: Horizon Notifier Chrome Tool
projects.problem: Students were missing critical portal updates (grades, announcements) because they had to manually log in to the university portal multiple times a day.
projects.solution: A lightweight Chrome extension that runs dual-mode background scans. It aggregates announcements and submittals into a real-time dashboard right in the browser.
projects.result: Live on the Chrome Web Store. Operates with zero external server dependencies, running securely on the client-side for absolute privacy and real-time alerts.

projects.title: School Principal Management App
projects.problem: School administrators often lack unified digital spaces to control administrative workflows, staff coordination, and daily operational tasks efficiently.
projects.solution: A robust, responsive dashboard engineered exactly for school principals. Built with React and secured via a Supabase architecture for real-time reliable data delivery.
projects.result: Live prototype deployed on Vercel, demonstrating how modern web stacks can securely handle complex administrative business logic.

projects.title: Smart Parking & Analytics
projects.problem: Traditional parking systems suffer from severe lookup latency and poor prioritization logic during peak traffic hours.
projects.solution: An intelligent management protocol leveraging specialized data structures (HashMap, LinkedList, Circular Queues) to optimize physical slot allocation and VIP prioritization.
projects.result: Achieved a 40% improvement in vehicle lookup time. Proves the value of choosing the correct backend algorithms for physical systems.

paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Developer at the Health & Population Department, Government of Punjab, where I've worked on 4 production applications used by thousands of people across health and HR. I'm also completing my B.Sc. in Software Engineering at UCP Lahore.

I work across the full stack, with ASP.NET Core, Angular and SQL Server day to day, and Node.js and React when the problem calls for it. My final year project is an AI deepfake-detection platform, and I'm building toward roles where solid engineering meets applied AI.
